blocks.text: This page tracks the Ladner MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $1,033,700 for a typical home, down 6.9% over twelve months.
Ladner benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical Ladner home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $1,033,700 in September 2026. That is down 2.6% on the month, down 5.3% over three months, down 3.8% over six months and down 6.9% over the year. Over three years it is down 11.6%, and over five years up 1.2%.
The weakest one-year move in Ladner was for a townhouse homes at −11.2%; the strongest was a detached home at −4.2%.
The gap between a detached home ($1,284,100) and an apartment ($586,400) is $697,700, and a townhouse ($919,800) sits $333,400 above the apartment benchmark.
Against Greater Vancouver, where the all-home benchmark was $1,075,900, Ladner is 3.9% below. Over the year Greater Vancouver moved down 5.5% against down 6.9% here.
Of the 20 areas this board reports, Ladner ranks 9 by all-home benchmark, with Squamish above it at $1,091,800 and Richmond below it at $1,015,800.

Detached homes in Ladner: benchmark $1,284,100, down 0.9% in a month, down 3.4% in three months, down 1.2% in six months, down 4.2% in a year, down 9.1% in three years and up 0.8% in five. That is 28.0% below the detached benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,784,700).

Townhouse homes in Ladner: benchmark $919,800, down 4.9% in a month, down 6.2% in three months, down 6.5% in six months, down 11.2% in a year, down 10.2% in three years and up 8.4% in five. That is 9.5% below the townhouse benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,016,700).

Apartment homes in Ladner: benchmark $586,400, down 3.7% in a month, down 9.8% in three months, down 9.1% in six months, down 10.5% in a year, down 20.1% in three years and down 3.5% in five. That is 14.1% below the apartment benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($682,500).

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in Ladner?
faq.a: In September 2026, a typical Ladner home was $1,033,700, with detached at $1,284,100.

faq.q: Are Ladner home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: Ladner is down 6.9% over twelve months and down 5.3% over three months.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
